Lily's favorite subject is English. The classroom is not far from my home. The science lab is big and clean. In fact, mum and I baked cookies together.
Lily usually eats rice for lunch. I like my life very much. The classroom is my favorite place. Also, the soup is too hot.
I am happy every day. My friend Grace is very kind. Grace likes rice too.
